approvals.guard.failed.text: This step's conditions are not met yet.
approvals.guard.failed.description: Why a workflow action is refused when its guard is false and the transition names no guardMessageKey of its own (APPROVALS-02; 422 GUARD_FAILED and the availability hint).

approvals.guard.error.text: This action can't be checked right now. Try again shortly.
approvals.guard.error.description: Why a workflow action is refused when its guard's facts could not be read or evaluated; the check fails closed (APPROVALS-02; 422 GUARD_ERROR and the availability hint).

approvals.permission.denied.text: You don't have permission to take this action.
approvals.permission.denied.description: Availability hint on a workflow action the caller lacks the transition's required permission for (APPROVALS-02).

approvals.countersign.pending.text: A decision is waiting for a countersignature.
approvals.countersign.pending.description: Availability hint on every other workflow action while a critical decision waits for a countersign (APPROVALS-02, ADR 0034).

approvals.countersign.self.text: Someone else must countersign your decision.
approvals.countersign.self.description: Availability hint on the countersign action for the person who made the pending decision (APPROVALS-02, ADR 0034).

approvals.comment.required.description: Why a workflow action or an approval step decision is refused without a comment: a transition marked requiresComment, a route rejection, or a route's finishing decision whose action needs one (APPROVALS-05, APPROVALS-04, APPROVALS-14; 422 COMMENT_REQUIRED).

approvals.route.pending.description: Why a route's own approve or reject action can't be taken directly while an approval route runs on the record (APPROVALS-04, ADR 0040; 409 ROUTE_PENDING and the availability hint).
